label.title: Label
label.description: Optional label useful for non-standard identities to give a bit more context.

scope.title: Scope
scope.description: Context in which the identity is meant to be used.

country.title: Country
country.description: Country from which the identity was issued.

key.title: Key
key.description: Uniquely classifies the identity, used instead of a type.

type.title: Type
type.description:
Type of code being represented, usually specific to a particular context,
country, or tax regime. Cannot be used alongside the key.

description.title: Description
description.description: Details about what the code means or implies.

ext.title: Extensions
ext.description: Additional structured information about the identity.

org.Identity.description: Identity is used to define a code for a specific context.
